author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
You don't need a skilled person to control the AI, you just need someone who has common sense and is willing to learn. 

Stop saying only senior developers can use AI effectively.  An eager junior can catch up to the level of a lazy senior in merely a few months.

A senior developer has 10 years of work experience, but how many hours of learning did he have in those 10 years?
